nextEvents.title: EVENTS
nextEvents.description: YSBR events are not just entertainment: they are experiences to be lived. Moments where sport, music and nature come together, creating real connections between people and places. From festivals to outdoor events, every project is born to empower the community, support the independent scene and experience every space in an active and mindful way. Unique events united by the same energy: sharing, moving, living.

joinUs.title: JOIN THE FAM

joinUs.benefits_intro: Being part of the Fam allows you to:
joinUs.benefit1: · Participate in activities and events reserved for members
joinUs.benefit3: · Contribute to the growth of an independent and authentic community

FAM.title: FAM
FAM.description: YESBRO ASD (YSBR) is an Amateur Sports Association founded in 2022. We combine unconventional sports, music and nature into authentic and inclusive experiences. From snowboarding to kitesurfing, from slacklining to animal flow: moving, discovering and sharing is our mantra. An open, sustainable and mindful community. Make room for adventure. Join the Fam.

SPORT.title: SPORT
SPORT.description: For YSBR, sport is not about performance, but personal and collective expression. We promote outdoor disciplines and sports activities as tools for connection, growth and freedom. Whether on water, land or immersed in nature, sport becomes a way to know yourself, push your limits and share authentic experiences. The level doesn't matter: it's the attitude that counts. Participate, push further, do it together. Sport is our universal language. It's what moves us, always.

MUSICA.title: MUSIC
MUSICA.description: Music is connection, culture, vibration and identity. Through events, DJ sets and sound projects, we create spaces where people can meet, dance and feel part of something unique. YSBR supports the underground and independent scene, empowering artists, crews and communities that share our vision. Every event is an experience: sounds, energy and freedom merging into an unforgettable moment. Music is the heartbeat of our community and what ignites everything else.

NATURA.title: NATURE
NATURA.description: YSBR was born and grows with a deep bond with the environment, the sea, the mountains and open spaces. We believe in an active and mindful lifestyle that respects the land and celebrates its beauty. Because for us, nature is home — a fundamental part of our identity. It's balance, freedom and inspiration. Our outdoor activities are an invitation to slow down, breathe and live authentic experiences, away from the noise.

KITE.title: KITE SURF
description: Alessandro and Ben met on the water: a broken kite, a hand offered without hesitating, and a real friendship within minutes.

Ben guides you step by step: from your first rides, if you're starting from zero, to jumps and freestyle, if you already ride. On the water we use Ventum Kiteboarding gear, a new and super affordable brand.
The course is only the beginning: you join a group that shares the same passion, between outings and trips. The dream? The YESBRO Surf House.

kitesurfPage.title: KITESURF LESSONS
kitesurfPage.subtitle: on Lake Como
kitesurfPage.lead: Lessons for beginners and advanced riders with an IKO instructor: from your first rides to jumps and freestyle, step by step, with Ventum Kiteboarding gear.
story: Alessandro and Ben's project started with a special encounter.
A day out kiting, Alessandro's kite ending up in the water after a part broke, and Ben turning up without hesitating to ask whether he needed a hand.
kitesurfPage.storyQuote: A few minutes in the water were enough for a real friendship to be born, the kind you can't quite explain.
storyOutro: Alessandro, president of YESBRO ASD, has been kiting since 2017 alongside a thousand other sports, because sitting still just isn't his thing: his energy is contagious, and there's no way to get bored around him.
That encounter gave birth to the project that is now the YSBR Kitesurf School: the same passion, shared with anyone who wants to start.
kitesurfPage.storyImageAlt: Kiter on the beach holding the bar
kitesurfPage.peopleTitle: WHO GUIDES YOU ON THE WATER

people.name: Ben
people.bio: A young athlete with the drive of someone who never stops: travelling, trying different spots and spending whole days on the water in every kind of wind. Today he rides at a high level, with a confidence he knows how to pass on to whoever learns with him: the IKO certification is only the starting point, the rest is real experience, earned on the water.

kitesurfPage.stepsIntro: On Lake Como you'll be guided step by step: from handling the kite on land all the way to jumps and freestyle. For beginners, equipment and boat are always included.

steps.title: On land
steps.text: Setting up the gear, safety rules and handling the kite: the basics, before you get in the water.

steps.title: In the water
steps.text: You learn to control the kite in the water and let it pull you, with the instructor and the boat always close by.

steps.title: On the board
steps.text: Water start and first rides: the moment you really start to fly.

steps.title: In the air
steps.text: Progress in style. You learn freestyle moves, jumps and everything that will make you super stylish, always safely.

kitesurfPage.communityTitle: THE COURSE IS ONLY THE BEGINNING
kitesurfPage.community: You join a group that shares the same passion, with outings, trips and experiences to live together: it's what makes us feel best.
kitesurfPage.dreamText: There's no permanent base on the lake yet, but we're working on it. Until then we're on the move: we load up the van and head wherever the wind is right.

faq.question: Do I need any experience to start?
faq.answer: No. Beginner lessons start from zero: from handling the kite on land to your first rides.

faq.question: Do you also teach riders who can already kite?
faq.answer: Yes. With advanced lessons you progress with jumps and freestyle moves, always safely. Message us and we'll set them up together.

faq.question: What is included in the price?
faq.answer: In beginner lessons, equipment and boat are always included, both in the single lesson and in the 4-hour package.

faq.question: What gear do you use?
faq.answer: Ventum Kiteboarding gear: a new and super affordable brand.

faq.question: How much does a kitesurf course cost?
faq.answer: You'll find all prices in the price list above: single lesson, 4-hour package and boat lift. For advanced lessons, message us on WhatsApp. YSBR membership is added to every activity.

faq.question: I already have my own gear: can I come out with you?
faq.answer: Yes: for independent riders there's the boat lift, which is just the boat transport, without a lesson.

faq.question: Why do I need a membership?
faq.answer: YSBR is an amateur sports association (YESBRO ASD) and all activities are reserved for members. With the membership you join the FAM and can also take part in the association's events.

faq.question: Where do the lessons take place?
faq.answer: On Lake Como. There's no permanent base yet, but we're working on it: message us and we'll tell you where we're heading out.

faq.question: Who is the instructor?
faq.answer: You'll be guided by Ben, the FAM's IKO certified instructor.

faq.question: How do I book?
faq.answer: Message Alessandro or Ben on WhatsApp: you'll find their numbers below and in the price list.

kitesurfPage.closing: Come and give it a go: the FAM is waiting for you on the water!

sections.title: Data collected
sections.body:
This website does not directly collect personal data from users through proprietary tracking systems or registration areas.

The association membership form is managed by Cognitoforms, a third-party service subject to its own privacy policy.

The site also provides a "Collaborate" form that lets you send a message (name, email and text) through your own email client: the data entered is sent only via email to the association and is not stored by the site.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: This site does not use profiling or marketing cookies. Only technical cookies strictly necessary for the hosting server (Aruba S.p.A.) operation may be present. These do not require user consent under Art. 122 of the Italian Privacy Code.

sections.title: Third-party services
sections.body:
The site uses the following external services:

• Google Fonts — for loading web fonts. Google may collect the user's IP address (Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy)
• Cognitoforms — for the membership registration form
• Instagram and WhatsApp — external links to the association's profiles

sections.title: Server logs
sections.body: The hosting server (Aruba S.p.A.) may automatically collect browsing data such as IP address, date and time of access, and pages visited. This data is processed anonymously and in aggregate form for statistical and security purposes.

sections.title: User rights
sections.body: Under EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR), users have the right to access their personal data, request its rectification or deletion, restrict its processing, and object to its processing. To exercise these rights, please contact the Data Controller at the email address indicated above.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: The Data Controller reserves the right to modify this policy at any time, notifying users on this page.
